name: Cúcuta
registryBasis: Official San José de Cúcuta municipal sources identify the Subsecretaría de Gestión Catastral Multipropósito and the city cadastral portal. Its IDEEP open-data catalogue lists city parcel and building datasets with downloadable formats. This establishes local cadastral services and publicly advertised geometry products, but direct data retrieval and schema verification were blocked by an expired TLS certificate; no feature geometry or record values were downloaded.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The city catalogue advertises parcel downloads, but the source host fails standard TLS certificate verification. The separate citizen viewer is keyed by parcel identifier; no feature schema or geometry-only route was safely verified.

The direct HTTPS host for the catalogue failed standard certificate verification, so no archive or schema was retrieved; the separate cadastral-letter portal requires a parcel number and was not queried.
